extraction_notes: Performance values are read from Fig. 9 (CO2 conversion vs temperature) and Fig. 10 (CH4 selectivity vs CO2 conversion), so most performance values are approximate. The non-promoted Co-Al2O3 series is plotted in both scheme panels but was entered only once. The paper reports two carbon products, CO and CH4, but does not print CO selectivity, CH4 yield, CH4 formation rate, or space velocity; these were not computed. Catalyst loadings use the calculated reduced-catalyst Co and Pt wt% values from Table 1. Reaction conditions applied to all entries: 50 mg catalyst diluted with 20 mg SiO2, activation at 673 K in H2 for 10 h, methanation at 1 × 10^5 Pa, CO2:H2 = 1:4, total flow 30 mL min-1, gases detected for 30 minutes at each temperature.
